hook_en: Every attempt depends on its reliability.
metaphor: Une machine de contrôle inspectée par un dispositif de calibration indépendant : vérifier le vérificateur.
note: Résolution native retournée par le générateur ; aucune retouche locale ni superposition de texte. Deux variantes générées séparément depuis la base.

prompts.master: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset: editorial article cover, EXACT 1920 x 1080 pixels, landscape 16:9. Collection SYSTÈMES. Create a master illustration WITHOUT ANY TEXT, letters, numbers or pseudo-text. European editorial axonometric cutaway illustration with screenprint texture and crisp ink drafting, warm paper #F3EFE6, dark navy #121C2B, cobalt #2457F5, coral #FF5A4E, muted sage sparingly. Scene metaphor: an industrial quality-control gate over a conveyor belt inspecting geometric blocks, and a larger separate calibration instrument inspecting the gate itself. One malformed cobalt block has passed through the gate; its distortion is subtle but clearly visible. A continuous coral thread follows the belt and loops upward through the calibration instrument, communicating the need to verify the verifier. On right 55% of cover, generous scale but uncluttered. Reserve left 45% completely airy and blank for a later three-line headline, a small series label top left and signature bottom left. Machine resembles tangible workshop equipment, no glowing futuristic robots, brains, padlocks, code, glossy3D, cyberpunk or gradients. Nothing written anywhere. Match a sophisticated French print illustration in warm ivory and navy. Save master unlettered.
prompts.fr: Use case ads-marketing. Generate a finished French editorial article cover EXACTLY 1920 x 1080 pixels, 16:9. Reference role: the supplied unlettered master is visual direction, not a locked background. Preserve the industrial quality-control gate, the larger calibration instrument inspecting it, geometric cobalt blocks, continuous coral thread, warm ivory paper/navy engraving, screenprint texture, airy axonometric SYSTÈMES family. Recompose if needed to avoid any important machine or thread cropped at edges. All text left aligned in generous left 45%, strong condensed sans serif, maximum three headline lines. Text to render VERBATIM: top label "L’ORACLE · 03"; main title "QUI VÉRIFIE L’ORACLE ?" split in two lines 'QUI VÉRIFIE' then 'L’ORACLE ?', use cobalt on ORACLE only, rest navy; small subtitle "Chaque essai engage sa fiabilité."; signature bottom left "KÉVIN BRUNET". Typography integrated naturally with illustration, editorial hierarchy matching a French literary magazine. Text exact accents and apostrophes. Illustration occupies right55% with generous safe margins. No text anywhere else, no pseudo-text, no duplicate words, no watermark, no floating white rectangles. Render at exact1920x1080. CORRECTION TO FRAMING: The earlier French result cut the calibration machine off at the top. Recreate from the master reference, reduce the illustration scale and move down sufficiently so the calibration machine is fully visible, with at least 80 pixels of warm-paper margin above and a safe margin at right. Entire essential gate and calibration instrument must be inside the canvas. Keep exactly the same French text and editorial hierarchy; main title two lines 'QUI VÉRIFIE' / 'L’ORACLE ?', subtitle 'Chaque essai engage sa fiabilité.', label 'L’ORACLE · 03', signature 'KÉVIN BRUNET'. Make subtitle visually lighter and small, so main title dominates. Exact1920x1080output.
